profile.headline: engineering a solution to climate change. blm.
profile.summary:
Committed to a Sustainable & Equitable Future Built on Virtues

Passionate about driving a global shift toward renewable energy and sustainable development.
   -   Advancing efficient energy capture methods and innovative storage solutions to strengthen renewable reliability.
   -   Supporting nuclear fusion research as a pathway to long-term clean energy.

Committed to financial empowerment and social justice.
   -   Exploring models for basic income supplementation, including the potential of cryptocurrency.
   -   Backing judicial activists defending marginalized communities and promoting equity.

Dedicated to protecting ecosystems and fostering environmental resilience.
   -   Supporting organizations addressing pollution, waste removal, and greenhouse gas reduction.

Always open to collaboration, new ideas, and bold initiatives that move us toward a more sustainable and just future.

company.name: Orbital Launch Vehicle Team at Virginia Tech

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
ASTRA: EWS (Satellite Constellation Project - Air Force Funded)
   - Software integration testing for onboard optics hardware
   - Embedded system framework design and development
   - GUI and CLI programs for downlink capabilities (from scratch)
ASTRA Lite: Edge Mirukuru (LiDAR Machine Learning Project)
   - Tree identification, classification, and data manipulation
         - Using k-nearest neighbors and supervised neural networks

positions.title: Software Researcher - Space@VT
positions.description:
Computer science and optics team on the ThickSat Project. Developing software for a Nucleo-144 board in C. Compiling a NOAA Compliance Report for the satellite’s optics.
Satellite software controls team on the NextGen Core Project. The first mission being for VT Inspire Fly’s NASA Astranis SEDS-SAT Award Winning ContentCube; to be used as a general purpose satellite controller in the future. Developing software for a Hercules LaunchPad Board on FreeRTOS in C.
